title: PROJECT 100 Master Analysis Reference
scope: Saved reviewed-recording edition and current nutrition models; no new exhaustive video screening

corrections.archived_statement: The older PDF describes a validated dry SMM corridor and a fixed BIA water offset.
corrections.current_finding: The current reconciled record explicitly excludes unsupported personal biological ceilings and fixed water-offset claims.
corrections.editorial_action: Do not repeat those ranges as measured physiology. Preserve the personal goal and separately dated observations.

corrections.archived_statement: The older Guidebook prints 14 December 2025 for the 88.2 lb benchmark.
corrections.current_finding: The owner-confirmed benchmark date in current-metrics is 2 December 2025.
corrections.editorial_action: Use the current date while retaining the archived discrepancy in the correction history.

corrections.archived_statement: The older Guidebook prints V1 XOR V6 equals one, implying one must be used.
corrections.current_finding: Current website rule is at most one on a training day; both are inactive on rest days.
corrections.editorial_action: Replace mandatory either-or language; do not invent a compulsory stimulant branch.

corrections.archived_statement: Historical 2780 kcal, 252 g protein and 69 g fat appear as ceilings or a completed daily account in older material.
corrections.current_finding: Current website calls these historical planning figures; whole-day intake verification remains deferred.
corrections.editorial_action: Do not total a few recipes and announce a verified daily intake.

corrections.archived_statement: Saved edition-coverage metadata still reports 25 canonical entries.
corrections.current_finding: The current exercise array has 31 after six new Pilates-kit adaptations.
corrections.editorial_action: Use 31 for the current snapshot and retain 25 as the pre-expansion count.

corrections.archived_statement: Broad screening and compiled guide completion can sound like exhaustive video analysis.
corrections.current_finding: Inventory contains 740 files; 18 representative long recordings are marked sequentially screened, one partial and 24 pending.
corrections.editorial_action: State the exact review scope; set and repetition counts remain unverified.

corrections.archived_statement: Historical data fields retain three level assignments.
corrections.current_finding: The user removed level selectors and editions; the trainer selects resistance.
corrections.editorial_action: Treat older level fields as superseded schema, not current instruction.

corrections.archived_statement: Older photo estimates have uncertain dressing inclusion and may differ from current models.
corrections.current_finding: Current models use disclosed ingredient ranges and include a whole prepared dressing batch.
corrections.editorial_action: Keep archive estimates separate from current modeled ranges and actual consumption.

corrections.archived_statement: The full and quick Pilates downloads both have eight pages.
corrections.current_finding: Both currently contain the same two day sequences of twelve cards.
corrections.editorial_action: Describe the overlap honestly; do not imply an extra abridged analysis that is not present.

corrections.archived_statement: There are 18 sequential review statuses, but only 15 detailed recordingCoverage objects.
corrections.current_finding: The review CSV and detailed coverage notes provide different levels of documentation.
corrections.editorial_action: Retain both; absence of a detailed object is not proof that a recording was never screened.
